Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Daley wrote:

> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
>>Monger.vekn.org allows searching by artist.
>
> Thanks LSJ! I had been to that site before and noticed it lists the
> artist though... I am having some difficulty in performing a search
> for an artist. In the advanced and standard search there doesn't
> appear to be that option. Just wondering if I am missing something.
> Can you inform me how to use the monger to search for artists?

You'll have to edit your preferences (click the "preferences" link
in the middle column of the homepage monger.vekn.org) to activate
"Include Artist Select Box". That option will add the ability to
search by artist on the advanced search pages.


